title: Set 6

sentences.ko: 이직할지 말지 계속 고민 중이야. 결정한 줄 알았는데 또 마음이 바뀌더라니까.
sentences.text: I don't know if I should take the job or stay here. Every time I think I've decided, I change my mind again.

alts.text: I keep going back and forth on the whole job thing, I just can't land on one answer.
I am still uncertain whether I should accept the new position or remain in my current role, and each time I believe I have made a decision, I reconsider.

sentences.note: **change my mind** 는 결정했다가 다시 흔들릴 때 쓰는 표현이에요.
sentences.situation: 친구한테 고민 상담하면서 결론은 못 내리기

sentences.ko: 위층 애들이 매일 밤 12시에도 뛰어다녀. 조용히 해 달라고 두 번이나 말했는데 하나도 안 바뀌었어.
sentences.text: My upstairs neighbor's kids run around at midnight every night. I've asked them to keep it down twice, and nothing's changed.

alts.text: The people upstairs are still stomping around at midnight, I've told them twice and it hasn't done a thing.
The family living above us continues to make noise at midnight every night, and despite asking them twice to be quieter, nothing has changed.

sentences.note: **keep it down** 은 조용히 해 달라고 부탁할 때 쓰는 표현이에요.

sentences.ko: 여기 예전엔 진짜 맛있었는데 요즘 완전 별로야. 닭튀김도 예전엔 바삭했는데 이제 눅눅하기만 해.
sentences.text: This place used to be amazing, but it's really gone downhill. The chicken used to be crispy, now it's just soggy.

alts.text: Not gonna lie, this place isn't what it used to be, the chicken's soggy now instead of crispy.
This restaurant used to be excellent, but the quality has declined significantly in recent months. The chicken, for example, used to be crispy, but now it is simply soggy.

sentences.note: **gone downhill** 은 예전보다 질이 떨어졌을 때 쓰는 표현이에요.

sentences.ko: 야, 진짜 오랜만이다! 요즘 어떻게 지내? 아직 그 회사 다녀, 아니면 옮겼어?
sentences.text: Hey, it's been forever! What have you been up to these days? Are you still at the same job, or did you end up switching?

alts.text: So what's new with you? Still at the same job, or did you end up switching?
It has been quite a while since we last spoke. How have you been recently? Are you still working at the same company, or have you moved on?

sentences.note: **What have you been up to** 는 요즘 어떻게 지내는지 물을 때 쓰는 표현이에요.

sentences.ko: 몇 달 만에 처음 달렸더니 온몸이 다 쑤셔. 오늘 아침엔 침대에서 일어나기도 힘들었어.
sentences.text: I went for a run for the first time in months, and now my whole body's sore. I could barely get out of bed this morning.

alts.text: I finally worked out after ages and now I'm wrecked, could barely drag myself out of bed.
I exercised for the first time in several months, and my entire body has been sore ever since. I found it quite difficult to get out of bed this morning.

sentences.note: **sore** 는 운동 뒤 근육이 쑤시고 아플 때 쓰는 말이에요.

reviewed: 위층 소음 문장의 formal 문장이 '자정(midnight)'이라는 구체적 시각을 '밤 늦게(late at night)'로 뭉뚱그려서 뜻이 바뀌었습니다. 원문대로 '자정'을 살렸습니다.
가게가 예전만 못하다 문장의 casual 문장이 본문과 같은 표현(gone downhill, used to be crispy now it's just soggy)을 거의 그대로 반복해서 앞부분이 겹쳤습니다. 관용구 없이 더 짧고 축약된 구어로 다시 썼습니다.
같은 문장의 formal 문장이 닭튀김이 눅눅해졌다는 구체적인 내용을 빼먹고 '전반적으로 질이 떨어졌다'로만 뭉뚱그렸습니다. 원래 내용을 살려 다시 썼습니다.
오랜만에 운동한 문장의 formal 문장이 '오늘 아침 침대에서 일어나기 힘들었다'는 뒷문장을 통째로 빼먹었습니다. 그 내용을 되살려 넣었습니다.
